title: Billing Dispute Resolution Standard for Patient Invoices & Statements
content:
A billing dispute on a Patient Invoices & Statements invoice is accepted only within the billing class's dispute filing window, counted in calendar days after the first statement date.

## Standard

**1. Filing window.** A billing dispute is accepted only within the billing class's dispute filing window, in calendar days after the first statement date. The filing window counts calendar days with the first statement date as day 0, the last day included. The first statement date is the one recorded on the disputed invoice. The window is 120 calendar days on the Self-Pay Patient Invoice and the Consumer Test Purchase Invoice and 180 calendar days on the Insured Patient Responsibility, Out-of-Network Balance, Medicare Beneficiary Liability and Medicaid Copay invoices.

**2. Decision time.** A dispute is decided within the billing class's decision time, in business days.

**3. Estimate variance.** For a self-pay or consumer invoice whose billed amount exceeds the good faith estimate on the order by at least the class's estimate-variance threshold, an estimate-variance dispute is settled under the class's estimate-variance settlement by adjusting the balance down to the estimate; a smaller variance is not an estimate dispute. The threshold is 400.00 on the Self-Pay Patient Invoice and the Consumer Test Purchase Invoice; on the four insured classes it is 0.00, meaning not applicable.

**4. Billing errors.** A billing error confirmed by the review is corrected by an adjustment of the billing error correction type.

**5. Disagreement with a payer.** A dispute that only disagrees with a payer's decision is referred to the claim process under Insurance Coverage & Claims, not adjusted.

## Filing window boundaries (hypothetical first statement date 15 January 2026)

| Filing date | Day of the count | 120-day window | 180-day window |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 January 2026 | day 0 | accepted | accepted |
| 15 May 2026 | day 120 | accepted, the last day | accepted |
| 16 May 2026 | day 121 | not accepted | accepted |
| 14 July 2026 | day 180 | not accepted | accepted, the last day |
| 15 July 2026 | day 181 | not accepted | not accepted |

## Estimate variance cases (hypothetical self-pay invoices, nothing yet paid)

| Good faith estimate | Billed amount | Variance | Estimate dispute | Balance after settlement |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 600.00 | 1,000.00 | 400.00, equal to the threshold | Yes | 600.00 |
| 600.00 | 999.99 | 399.99, below the threshold | No | — |
| 250.00 | 910.00 | 660.00 | Yes | 250.00 |
